entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: Remains of the Demonic Leviathan fought by Nicol Bolas, thought to be two rocks near the Madaran Empire.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought the Demonic Leviathan and later recreated the gates.

entities.name: Demonic Leviathan
entities.description: Creature Bolas fought in the first planeswalker duel.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: The Nightwalker who destroyed the gates in a fight with Bolas.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Weakened the boundaries between Dominaria and Kamigawa.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War in which the gates were the main route.

events.summary: Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, weakening the boundaries between Dominaria and Kamigawa.
events.quote: Due to Ravi ringing her Apocalypse Chime

events.summary: In a fight with Bolas, Leshrac destroys the Talon Gates; Bolas recreates them after his defeat.
events.quote: the Talon Gates were destroyed by the Nightwalker, but shortly after his defeat, they were recreated by Bolas

relations.quote: During a fight between Nicol Bolas and Leshrac
